hooks.name: Lint backend Python on save
hooks.description: Runs ruff on the backend after a Python file is saved. Uses ruff from PATH or from EVIDENCE_PROGRAMS_ROOT; skips with a message if neither exists.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = (Get-Command ruff -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $r -and $env:EVIDENCE_PROGRAMS_ROOT) { $c = Join-Path $env:EVIDENCE_PROGRAMS_ROOT 'EvidenceRAG\backend-venv\Scripts\ruff.exe'; if (Test-Path $c) { $r = $c } }; if (-not $r) { Write-Output 'ruff not found; set EVIDENCE_PROGRAMS_ROOT or add ruff to PATH. Skipped.'; exit 0 }; & $r check backend; exit 0"
